_comment: Shaped like the example response of GET /api/snapmirror/relationships in the ONTAP 9.18.1 REST API reference (https://docs.netapp.com/us-en/ontap-restapi-9181/get-snapmirror-relationships.html), restricted to the fields the collector requests. The path svm1:volume1, the first UUID, lag_time PT8H35M42S and the unhealthy_reason codes and messages 6621444/6621445 come from that example; the other UUIDs and paths are placeholders derived from it, and the third record models an uninitialized relationship, which has no lag_time.

unhealthy_reason.message: Failed to complete update operation on one or more item relationships.
